insight。模型先在上下文中利用失败反馈生成短 insight，再通过对这些 insight token 打开反向传播，把“遇到这类任务时应注意什么”压回参数。这个思路对 RL pretrain、持续自我改进、困难任务课程训练都有参考意义。它说明在成功样本极少时，直接优化最终答案 token 可能不是最好的第一步；先学习问题诊断和错误规避规则，反而能让 RL 重新获得可用梯度。","technical_approach":"方法有两个相互配合的部分。第一部分改采样。常规 GRPO 对同一任务做 K 条独立并行 rollout，失败之间互不通信。RLTL;DR 改成顺序尝试：每次失败后运行 verifier，得到错误信息、assert 失败、traceback 或最终状态检查结果；随后让同一个 policy 阅读上一轮尝试和 verifier 输出，写一个很短的 TL;DR insight，例如“搜索结果需要分页”。下一次 rollout 把任务和历史 insight 一起放进上下文。这样做的目的不是让模型在测试时也多轮试错，而是在训练采样阶段把完全没有成功样本的任务推到至少出现一次成功的区域。\n\n第二部分改更新。只做顺序采样还不够，因为测试时模型必须第一轮就回答，不能依赖训练时积累的 insight 上下文。论文因此对上下文中的 self-generated insight token 打开 backpropagation mask。每条 insight 约 17 个 token，作为用户消息插入上下文，但训练时允许这些 token 承担 SFT-style loss。这样模型学习的不是“生成某个最终答案”，而是从任务描述映射到一个高层提醒。GRPO loss 仍可作用在 rollout action token 上，使用 clipped objective，clip 参数为 0.2；但消融显示，insight token 上的监督信号才是主要来源。这个设计和普通 self-reflection 的区别在于：reflection 不只是推理时上下文技巧，而是被作为可反传的训练目标写入参数。","experiments":"实验使用 Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking 作为基座 agent，任务是 agentic 1%。\n\n顺序采样阶段本身显著改善探索：在原来并行独立采样完全找不到成功的任务上，使用失败后生成的 TL;DR insight 进行连续尝试，可以让 Pass@k 达到 14% 到 59%，也就是训练缓冲区里开始出现正样本。但如果只在采样时使用 insight，而不把 insight 学进参数，测试时去掉顺序采样和上下文 insight 后，性能接近原始模型。\n\n完整 RLTL;DR For a query x and prior history C, the writer produces query-conditioned textual memory M containing relevant evidence, temporal relations, and derived facts. A compressor encodes M through the first four blocks of a frozen backbone and maps it into K continuous vectors Z. The reader generates responses conditioned on x and Z. During on-policy training, the student samples a response under soft memory. A frozen teacher, initialized from the same reader but conditioned on textual memory M, scores the identical token sequence. Token-level log-probability gaps reveal positions where the textual-memory reader is more confident than the compressed-memory reader. A small language model is fit to the data from round t−1 and then used to score both round t−1 and round t data with negative log-likelihood. If the new round has higher NLL under the previous-round model, it contains content that the previous distribution does not explain. Under an exact distributional fit, the quantity decomposes into KL divergence between the two round distributions plus the change in entropy. This separates distribution shift from diversity change. The proposed ATRI module uses the signal in two ways: within a round, samples with above-average information gain receive larger weights; across rounds, training stops when the gain remains below a threshold for consecutive rounds.","experiments":"The paper reports evaluations on several common self-evolution datasets and compares ATRI against filtering- and regularization-based baselines. The UMM has a generator G and an understanding branch U. Starting from an image, U proposes several textual descriptions. Candidates are filtered for consistency with the source image, so the solver is challenged by valid rather than corrupted examples. G then attempts each admitted description several times, and attempts are scored by image-text agreement and consistency with the original source. The candidate with the lowest mean solver score becomes the challenge, and the solver is updated with GRPO on its sampled attempts. The same procedure runs in the opposite direction from text to images. The main difference from adversarial training with a discriminator is that no extra adversary is trained. The adversary is a pool of selected model outputs. 的条件概率变化。这样可以避免“换图后模型生成了另一条轨迹”带来的混杂因素。作者定义 EFS 来度量图像干预对 claim token 预测分布的影响强度；如果模型真的在用视觉证据，EFS 应该上升。但仅有 EFS 不够，因为整条轨迹在换图后可能出现全局 likelihood 漂移，所以作者又定义 claim persistence，并用同一 rollout 中的 residual tokens 做校准，试图扣除轨迹级别的整体分布变化，专门看“这个 claim 自身是否仍被支持”。这一步是论文最关键的分析设计，因为它把“视觉敏感”与“视觉可撤回”分开了。\n\n在此基础上，作者提出 Persistence-Aware Credit Gating，简称 PACG。训练时先识别 routed direct visual claims，也就是那些被判定为直接依赖视觉证据的 token span。对于正 advantage 的 token，如果对应 claim 在反事实图像下能明显 retract，就保留完整正信用；如果 claim 异常 persistent，即证据被破坏后仍维持高支持度，则衰减其正信用。负 advantage token 和非 routed token 不做改动。这样设计很克制：它不直接惩罚所有视觉 token，也不需要 claim 的人工真值标签，只是在“本来会被奖励”的位置上做选择性减弱。作者强调 PACG 可组合到 DAPO、VPPO 这类现有 RLVR 优化器上，而且没有推理时额外开销。\n\n和已有 perception reward、token reweighting、multimodal PRM 的区别在于，这篇工作不主要问“哪些 token 看了图”，而是问“这些 token 排序候选轨迹，而不是直接按原始 staleness 丢弃。分数由 Waiting Staleness 加上加权后的 Generation Staleness 构成。Waiting Staleness 被完整保留，因为它主要来自 pool 中可避免的排队。Generation Staleness 则乘以由 Prefix Forgetting Score 映射得到的权重。Prefix Forgetting Score 衡量当前策略相对生成策略在前缀 token log-probability 上的漂移，用来区分“只是生成时间长”与“策略已经忘掉这段前缀”。这样做可以减少一个常见偏差：长轨迹、难题更容易有高 generation lag，如果直接按 lag 丢弃，会把训练集推向短而容易的样本。","experiments":"实验在六个数学推理 benchmark 上比较同步 的平均准确率提升。结果说明，简单异步虽然提高资源重叠，但 staleness 会明显损伤学习；只要在 pool 层过滤掉有效滞后最高的 surplus trajectories，可以保留异步吞吐的大部分收益，同时接近或略好于同步训练的最终质量。","reading_guide":"建议泛读，预计 25–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对异步 RL 训练瓶颈和 staleness LLM post-training. As rollout workers generate trajectories while the trainer keeps updating the policy, completed samples may be trained under a policy that is several versions ahead of the behavior policy. The key decomposition is into Generation Staleness, accumulated before a trajectory finishes, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated while completed trajectories sit in the pool. The practical question is how many completed trajectories to reject and which ones, under a fixed allocation of rollout and trainer resources.","importance":"The paper is most relevant to the systems side of RL post-training, especially for long-horizon reasoning where rollout cost dominates. It does not change the pretraining objective, but it gives a useful lens on training-signal freshness. Instead of treating staleness as a single version gap, it separates unavoidable generation delay from avoidable pool waiting, then uses queue pressure as a control signal. This is a useful complement to importance-weight correction and fixed lag windows. For foundation-model training, the broader lesson is that sample quality also depends on when a trajectory reaches the optimizer, not only on the reward or prompt distribution.","technical_approach":"PACE, or Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness, operates at the completed-trajectory pool. Pool occupancy determines an adaptive rejection budget: if the pool is overfilled, PACE rejects more surplus trajectories; if ready data is scarce, it relaxes rejection to avoid starving the trainer. Candidate trajectories are ranked by an effective staleness score rather than raw lag. The score keeps Waiting Staleness in full and adds Generation Staleness weighted by a Prefix Forgetting Score. This prefix score measures drift in prefix token log-probabilities between the generation policy and the current policy. 目标与真实更新量更一致。论文里还说明 ACPO 可以无缝嵌入 PPO 和 GRPO 这类框架，而不需要重写整个训练流程。理论部分有两条主线。第一条是二阶矩分析：在显式假设下，ACPO 的梯度估计二阶矩不大于 PPO；在额外假设下，还能推出方差更低。这里的重点不是一个很强的最优性结论，而是给出“为什么裁 rA 比只裁 r 更稳”的形式化解释。第二条是与 policy mirror descent A decoder can be made arbitrarily insensitive to sensitive directions, driving output leakage close to zero, while the hidden representation still encodes the sensitive content. The empirical part then probes hidden states across layers using generative probe decoders rather than only linear classifiers. This matters because sensitive knowledge may not be linearly readable, but may still be reconstructable by a stronger generative decoder. The paper also positions this against RMU, sparse-autoencoder editing, and activation steering: these methods intervene on representations, but often assume that the target information is concentrated in identifiable directions or features. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal and causally biases downstream retrieval toward the sycophantic answer. It includes directional error discovery, per-input detection of channel-associated states, router-conditioned intervention, destination-resolved verification over the full K-way action space, and statistical licensing under pre-specified rules. The action space includes direct response, API/tool call, clarification request, and task declination. An error channel is represented as an ordered pair c = y* → ŷ0, where y* is the reference action and ŷ0 is the frozen model’s baseline action. Interventions are keyed to channels and applied only when the router fires. Its main lesson is that team scaling should not be evaluated only through task averages or at one fixed team size. Arithmetic word problems benefit substantially from more calls, while ARC, GPQA, and MMLU show little gain. For training, the diagnosis matters: coverage failures call for more diverse proposal generation, while transform failures call for better data for critique, verification, selection, and synthesis.","technical_approach":"The authors split each orchestration architecture into a generate stage and a transform stage. The generate stage is the first tier that emits parseable candidate answers, with size L. The transform stage contains critics, refiners, synthesizers, and the final manager. They evaluate eight DAG-style architectures: Star and Persona-Star mostly scale parallel proposals; Proposer-Critic, Tournament, Tree, and Diamond distribute calls between proposals and filtering or synthesis; Chain and Cascading-Chain add serial depth while keeping only one initial candidate. Requested budgets are N = 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, and 30 calls. The exact generate-transform decomposition separates added coverage, success on covered items, and recovery when the correct answer is not in the initial proposal set. This is more suitable than fixed-pool selection bounds for hierarchical managers, because the manager can synthesize an answer outside the observed proposal pool.","experiments":"The sweep covers five instruction-tuned 7–9B models, five short-answer benchmarks, and one executable-code benchmark. Proposer-Critic captures the arithmetic gains most effectively and ranks best in aggregate at the largest budget, while it can be weak on other tasks. Equal call budgets also hide cost differences: at the same 30-call budget, observed token cost varies by 2.1x across architectures. The decomposition attributes early saturation mainly to the transform term. The issue is compositional rather than a simple within-item decline: additional coverage tends to land on harder items, and those items are harder for the manager or synthesizer to convert even when useful evidence is present. The paper checks this pattern under both budget scaling and a controlled prompt-only intervention.","reading_guide":"A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"agent","cover_url":"/covers/2609_37743.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是长程 agent 执行里的一个具体但常被低估的问题：历史上下文不是越多越好，也不是只靠 recency 或语义相关性就能裁剪好。真正困难的地方在于，早先某次 tool 调用产出的局部信息，可能在很多步之后以变量、标识符、参数、约束条件等形式再次被复用；如果中间被压缩掉，模型当前这一步虽然看起来“语义上不太相关”，但执行上已经失去关键依赖。论文要解决的，就是如何在固定 history budget 下，把这类对后续执行仍有支撑作用的完整 tool result 保留下来，同时避免把整段历史都塞回上下文。","importance":"它对基座预训练不是直接方法贡献，更像是对 agent-time context management 的一项执行层改进，所以定级为 skim 是合适的。但它有两个启发点。第一，它把“上下文价值”从静态文本相关性，推进到“执行依赖中的可观测复用”，这对长上下文训练、memory 建模、tool-augmented pretrain 都有参考意义。第二，它说明很多 agent 失败并不是推理能力不够，而是历史状态表示不对；如果以后做原生 tool-use pretraining，可能需要把 execution dependency 作为训练信号，而不只是把轨迹串成纯文本。换句话说，这篇文章更像是在提醒：对 agent 来说，context 是程序状态的一部分，不只是 prompt。","technical_approach":"方法由三部分组成。第一是 persistent context graph。系统不把历史仅仅存成线性消息序列，而是把 message、tool call、tool result 作为节点持久化保存，同时保留时间顺序和引用关系。这样做的目的，是让“当前没放进上下文”的结果也不会丢失，后面还能被重新取回。\n\n第二是 Tool-Flow Analysis，简称 TFA。这是文章最关键的部分。它分析后续模型步骤和 tool 调用里出现的值，追踪这些值最早由哪个 tool result 引入，再把这种从早期结果到后续操作的连接记录成 observed reuse。这里的信号不是模型预测的 importance，而是执行过程中已经发生过的复用证据。论文强调，很多真正重要的信息并不一定在当前 query 上语义最相近，但如果它在执行链条里被多次引用，就应该提高保留优先级。这个设计和常见 retrieval memory 的差别在于：后者主要看当前查询与历史片段的匹配，前者额外利用了执行轨迹里的因果痕迹。\n\n第三是 renderer。每次模型调用前，renderer 在固定 token budget 内选择哪些历史 tool result 以完整形式放回上下文。打分信号由三类组成：observed reuse、recency、semantic relevance。未被选中的结果不会被删除，只是暂时不显示，仍保留在 graph 中供后续恢复。这个设计比一次性 summary 更稳，因为 summary 往往会丢掉后面才知道重要的细节。\n\n从方法取舍看，这篇工作没有走“让模型自己决定怎么压缩”的路线，也没有做复杂的 learned memory controller，而是用显式结构化状态和规则化信号来管理上下文。这样做的优点是可解释、可恢复、部署简单；代价是 TFA 对值流追踪的覆盖率和鲁棒性会决定上限，尤其当复用不是字面值级别，而是抽象语义级别时，信号可能不完整。","experiments":"实验在两个 benchmark 上做：AppWorld，以及 8-objective QA；执行模型用了三种。论文主结果集中在一个 primary 6K history budget 设定，也就是给 agent 先前执行历史分配 6K token 左右的可见预算，而不是把全部累计历史都传入。结论是，ContextRender 在这个较小预算下，任务表现接近甚至有时超过 full-history，同时相对 full-history 的平均标准化推理成本下降 10.2% 到 32.2%。\n\n和多种 managed-context baseline 相比，它在两个 benchmark、三种模型上都取得了最好的整体任务表现。这里最值得注意的不是单点分数，而是它在“更小上下文预算 + 不丢完整结果可恢复性”这个组合下仍能稳定工作，说明 observed reuse 确实补上了 recency / relevance 的盲区。\n\n消融实验是文章最有信息量的部分。加入 observed reuse 后，任务成功率和 later-reused result 的保留召回都有提升，尤其是那些经过较长时间间隔后才再次被使用的结果，召回增益更明显。这和论文的核心论点一致：长程依赖不是靠最近邻启发式能处理好的。若只看 recency，早期但关键的 tool result 很容易被挤出上下文；若只看 semantic relevance，包含 ID、路径、参数值、约束条件的结果也可能被低估。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 轨迹里是否还能稳定工作。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper addresses a practical failure mode in long-horizon LLM agents: context management based only on recency, truncation, or The key idea is to separate immediate usefulness from persistent trust. A rule extracted from the current episode can guide the rest of that episode, but it must pass prospective validation in later episodes before it becomes retrievable long-term knowledge. This is a cleaner interface than standard reflection or trajectory memory, which often waits until an output or episode is complete before updating memory.","technical_approach":"StepLearn is a nonparametric framework with fixed actor and auxiliary learner parameters. Each turn yields a transition consisting of the current observation, selected action, next observation, and optional feedback. From informative transitions, the learner extracts a hypothesis with three fields: an applicability condition, a policy, and an expected effect. The hypothesis is split into two copies. A runtime copy is available immediately from the next step within the same episode. A candidate copy is stored but cannot guide future episodes until it is validated. During validation, compatible hidden candidates register predictions before the agent acts; later observations provide evidence for or against the predicted effect. The source episode is excluded, and each later episode contributes at most one conclusive verdict per item. Candidates with enough support and predictive precision are promoted to verified memory. This turns sparse task feedback into testable intermediate predictions.","experiments":"The paper evaluates over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld.
